newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Malayan Bank only bidder for PNB unit.
newsitem.headline: Malayan Bank only bidder for PNB unit.

text.p: Malaysia's Malayan Banking Berhad emerged as the only bidder for the 60 percent stake of Philippine National Bank (PNB) in PNB-Republic Bank, PNB senior executive vice president Valentin Araneta said on Tuesday.

Prequalified bidders of PNB-Republic Bank were given until Monday to submit their offers for the stake. Apart from Malayan Banking Bhd, two others were earlier prequalified by the Central Bank -- Equitable Banking Corp from the Philippines and a group led by former banker Francisco Dizon.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Araneta said Malayan Banking was the only one that complied with the bidding rules and submitted an initial deposit of 80 million pesos.
He said PNB management will evaluate the bid. It may accept the offer not later than January 31, 1997 after securing the necessary approvals.
The floor price for the PNB stake was 800 million pesos. PNB did not disclose Malayan Banking's offer price.
